Since then our customer base has grown, we have a ton of momentum in the market, and we’re continuing to build a world-class sales organization.</p> <p>We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join our Enterprise Sales organization focusing on companies with 2,500+ employees. We’ve seen incredible success growing our customer base in this category with companies like Toast, Cruise, Rivian and many more. We intend to double down on this success and make Enterprise accounts central to our growth strategy.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll be reporting to our Enterprise Sales Leader. Additionally, you’ll be strategizing and executing on closing new business and expanding our footprint with existing customers.</p> <hr> <p><strong>On any given day you might find yourself:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for building new pipeline and driving revenue within your assigned territory</li> <li>Deeply understand your customers' business challenges and how to position Hex as the solution</li> <li>Partner with Sales Engineering to run discovery, demos, POCs, and technical reviews</li> <li>Manage the sales-cycle including lead generation, qualification and other deliverables for closing deals while consistently meeting and exceeding sales goals</li> <li>Provide input back to engineering, product management and marketing</li> <li>Create and deliver accurate forecasts</li> </ul> <hr> <h2>About You</h2> <p>To be successful in this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Proven track record selling technical software in the data, DS/ML, or analytics space</li> <li>Understand and be able to teach complex technical concepts.</li> <li>Can speak confidently about the challenges data practitioners encounter in their day-to-day workflows</li> <li>Passionate / curious about the data &amp; analytics space</li> <li>Capable of managing large, complex deal cycles involving multiple customer stakeholder groups</li> <li>Capable / willing to learn basic SQL (if you haven't already)</li> <li>Possess an enthusiasm for working as part of a team and an ability to partner successfully with cross-functional peers such as product, engineering, customer success, etc.</li> <li>Be comfortable in a fast-paced, often ambiguous environment.</li> <li>Love giving and receiving feedback.</li> </ul> <hr> <p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p> <p>The on-target-earnings (OTE) for this role is: $320,000<br><br>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p> <p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: <a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</span></a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-enterprise-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-enterprise-account-executive</a></p> Sat, 19 Sep 2026 07:31:10 +0000 Mon, 19 Oct 2026 07:31:10 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-enterprise-account-executive https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-enterprise-account-executive Hex Technologies: Cloud Security Engineer Anywhere in the World Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US) </p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p> <hr> <h3>About the role:</h3> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li> <li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li> <li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li> <li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li> <li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li> <li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li> </ul> <h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li> <li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li> <li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li> <li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li> <li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li> <li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li> <li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security –
